connector.name: Bluecolumn Memory
connector.registryDescription: Persistent semantic memory API for AI agents with Audio Intelligence.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package bluecolumn-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bluecolumnconsulting-lgtm account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BLUECOLUMN_API_KEY
env.description: Your BlueColumn API key. Get a free key at https://bluecolumn.ai

env.name: BLUECOLUMN_API_URL
env.description: BlueColumn API base URL for the audio-intelligence layer (/v1/audio/*, /v1/calls/*, /v1/sound/*, /v1/music/*). Defaults to http://localhost:8000 (local FastAPI backend).
